comparisons.peer_topic: 2023 Equity Incentive Plan Approval and Share Reservations
comparisons.peer_summary: On May 18, 2023, the Company approved the AMD 2023 Equity Incentive Plan, which supersedes the Prior Plans, with 87,645,874 shares reserved for future awards. As of December 28, 2024, 60 million shares were available for future grants, and 34 million shares were reserved for issuance upon exercise or vesting.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose the availability of shares for future grants under their equity incentive plans. NVDA reports 147 million shares available as of January 28, 2024, while AMD reports 60 million shares available for future grants as of December 28, 2024. AMD additionally notes that 87.6 million shares are reserved under its approved 2023 Plan, whereas NVDA's disclosure focuses on the pool available for future grants without explicitly detailing the reserved vs. available split in the provided sentence.

sentences.text: As of January 28, 2024 and January 29, 2023, there were 147 million and 160 million shares, respectively, of common stock available for future grants under our equity incentive plans.

As of December 28, 2024, the Company had 60 million shares of common stock that were available for future grants and 34 million shares reserved for issuance upon the exercise of outstanding stock options or the vesting of unvested RSUs, including PRSUs, under the 2023 Plan and the Prior Plans.
